categories.main_business_segments: Ningbo Tuopu Group primarily operates in automotive parts manufacturing, focusing on eight major business segments: NVH damping systems, interior and exterior systems, lightweight body components, intelligent cockpit parts, thermal management systems, chassis systems, air suspension systems, and intelligent driving systems. Additionally, the company has established an electric drive division targeting the embodied intelligence robot sector, aiming to create a new growth curve.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes forward-looking R&D with integrated capabilities in materials, mechanics, electronics, and software. It employs advanced manufacturing processes including rubber injection molding, multi-component fiber molding, stamping, forging, casting, CNC machining, SMT assembly, and automated production lines. Digital factory initiatives utilize MES systems, virtual simulation (DFM), AI visual inspection, AGV logistics, and RFID tracking to enhance quality and efficiency. Key technologies include intelligent air suspension, line-controlled braking (IBS), line-controlled steering (EPS), and thermal management modules with smart diagnostics.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Tuopu serves major domestic and international intelligent electric vehicle manufacturers and traditional OEMs. Domestic clients include Huawei-Seres, Li Auto, NIO, Chery, Great Wall, Xiaomi, BYD, Geely, and XPeng. Internationally, it collaborates with innovative US EV companies such as Rivian, Ford, GM, Stellantis, BMW, and Mercedes-Benz. The company’s products support the global new energy vehicle market and emerging robotics sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively in China with manufacturing bases in Ningbo, Chongqing, Wuhan, and other key automotive clusters. It has expanded internationally with factories and subsidiaries in the United States, Brazil, Malaysia, Poland, Mexico, Thailand, Sweden, and Canada. Ongoing projects include expansions in Mexico, Poland, and Thailand to enhance global footprint and mitigate trade risks.
categories.supply_chain_position: Tuopu operates primarily as a midstream automotive parts supplier, providing integrated modules and components to OEMs. It holds a platform supplier role with system-level product offerings and is vertically integrated in key areas such as chassis, thermal management, and intelligent driving systems. The company also extends upstream into materials R&D and downstream into system integration and module assembly.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic priorities include platform expansion across eight automotive product lines and robotics electric drive systems, technological innovation to solve industry bottlenecks, and intelligent manufacturing transformation. R&D investments focus on advanced chassis components, intelligent braking and steering systems, thermal management innovations, and robotics actuators. The company pursues Tier0.5 collaboration models with customers and globalized production to capture growth in new energy vehicles and robotics.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of automotive parts and modules to OEMs and tier-1 suppliers. The company also earns income from licensing and technology services related to its proprietary systems. Sales are conducted mainly via direct sales channels domestically and internationally, with a focus on volume growth and increasing per-vehicle content value.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Tuopu positions itself as a leading Chinese automotive parts platform supplier with a broad product portfolio and strong R&D capabilities. It competes with both domestic and international automotive parts manufacturers, leveraging its integrated product lines and Tier0.5 collaboration model to differentiate. The company is recognized for its technological leadership in intelligent chassis systems and is expanding into the robotics sector to diversify its competitive edge.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Tuopu achieved revenue of approximately RMB 26.6 billion, a 35% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders reaching RMB 3 billion, up nearly 40%. Total assets grew to RMB 37.5 billion, and equity attributable to shareholders increased by 42%. The company maintains a healthy asset-liability ratio of 47.84% and continues to invest heavily in capacity expansion and R&D, supporting a strong growth trajectory.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Tuopu offers customers a comprehensive, platform-based product portfolio covering critical automotive systems, enabling one-stop, modular solutions that enhance vehicle performance and reduce costs. Its forward-looking R&D and integrated manufacturing capabilities provide high-quality, innovative products such as advanced air suspension, line-controlled braking, and intelligent thermal management. The company’s Tier0.5 collaboration model ensures rapid response and deep integration with customers, fostering long-term partnerships and competitive advantage.
